source: វិទ្យាការទប់ស្កាត់ និងកម្ចាត់សមាសភាពបទព្រុងលើដំណាំទុរេន (Prevention and Control of Harmful Organisms on Durian), Cambodian technical extension document compiled with reference to CABI Crop Protection Compendium and durian pest/disease literature, 28pp
text: A swarming leaf beetle pest (scientific name not fully legible in the scanned source) feeds on young durian leaves, often in groups, chewing irregular holes in newly flushed foliage. Damage is mainly a concern on young, non-bearing trees where repeated defoliation of new flushes can slow the tree's growth and delay the start of bearing. General control approach described in the source: hand-collection of beetles where infestation is light and the orchard is small enough for this to be practical, and insecticide treatment targeted at new flush periods where infestation is heavy; exact product and rate were not legible in this pass.
